Done. Summary:

- **Diagnosis:** checkout-api was running v2.3.1, which was unhealthy in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate.
- **Rollback:** Rolled back all regions to **v2.3.0**, the most recent release that was healthy in production.
- **Verification:** Service is now healthy with an error rate of 0.2%.
- **Incident:** Opened SEV2 incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api unhealthy after deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0") describing the failure and the rollback action; the on-call engineer has been paged.

The service is stable on v2.3.0. A follow-up investigation into what broke v2.3.1 before any re-deploy attempt is recommended — and note that re-deploying v2.3.1 would require change-manager approval since it has never been healthy in production.
